title: High-throughput scNMT protocol for multiomics profiling of single cells from mouse brain and pancreatic organoids
author: Cerrizuela, Kaya, et al.
materials: The first PCR is a standard reverse transcription reaction with no amplification step. In the following PCR amplification step, generating a double stranded cDNA from the single stranded cDNA template needs to be optimized per cell type to ensure amplification of just sufficient cDNA with minimal PCR amplification bias. steps.title: Prepare Oligo‑dT bead reagents
steps.instruction:
Prepare the following buffers (store at 4 °C, 1 month unless noted):
- Dynabead solution A: 0.1 M NaOH (100 µL), 0.05 M NaCl (100 µL), ddH₂O to 10 mL.
- Dynabead solution B: 0.1 M NaCl (200 µL), ddH₂O to 10 mL.
- 2× Bind‑and‑Wash (B&W) buffer: 0.01 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (100 µL), 1 mM EDTA (20 µL), 2 M NaCl (4 mL), ddH₂O to 10 mL.
- G&T wash buffer: 0.05 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.3 (500 µL), 0.075 M KCl (250 µL), 3 mM MgCl₂ (30 µL), 0.01 M DTT (1 µL), 0.5 % Tween‑20 (50 µL), ddH₂O to 10 mL.
- PEG 50 % (w/v): 5 g PEG‑8000 in ddH₂O up to 10 mL (store 6 months, used for RT master mix).

steps.title: Bind Oligo‑dT to Dynabeads
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube add 225 µL MyOne Streptavidin C1 Dynabeads, place on magnet 30 s, discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 400 µL Solution A (magnet 30 s, discard supernatant each time). Resuspend in 200 µL Solution B, magnet 30 s, discard supernatant. Resuspend in 225 µL 2× B&W buffer, add 225 µL 100 µM Oligo‑dT‑SS3, rotate 15 min at 18‑25 °C. Store bead suspension at 4 °C overnight if needed.

steps.title: Prepare bead resuspension and RT mixes
steps.instruction:
Prepare three master mixes for a 384‑well plate (+15 % = 441.6 × reactions):
- Bead resuspension solution (4 µL per reaction): 3.1 µL ddH₂O, 0.8 µL 5× Buffer RT (Maxima), 0.1 µL RNase Inhibitor (40 U/µL).
- G&T wash buffer + RNase Inhibitor (15 µL per reaction): 14.85 µL G&T buffer, 0.15 µL RNase Inhibitor (40 U/µL).
- RT master mix (2 µL per reaction): 1.185 µL ddH₂O, 0.2 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 0.040 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.3, 0.060 µL 1 M NaCl, 0.050 µL 100 mM MgCl₂, 0.020 µL 100 mM GTP, 0.040 µL 100 µM TSO, 0.025 µL RNase Inhibitor (40 U/µL), 0.2 µL 50 % PEG, 0.160 µL 100 mM DTT, 0.020 µL 200 U/µL Maxima H‑minus RT. Store all mixes on ice until use.

steps.title: Generate single‑cell suspension (brain)
steps.instruction: Dissect mouse subventricular zone and olfactory bulb (≈15 min). Dissociate tissue with the Neural Tissue Dissociation Kit (Miltenyi) for 40 min following the manufacturer’s protocol. Label cells with antibodies and wash (30 min). Total time 2–3 h per mouse.

steps.title: Generate single‑cell suspension (organoids)
steps.instruction: Incubate pancreatic organoids with TrypLE Express for 30 min, wash and resuspend cells for 30 min. Total time ≈1 h.

steps.title: Reverse transcription of mRNA
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL 1× RT buffer to each well containing Oligo‑dT beads, vortex 30 s, spin, incubate on magnet 3 min, discard supernatant. Add 5 µL TSO‑wash cDNA amplification master mix (if performing TSO wash) or proceed directly to cDNA amplification master mix (3 µL).

steps.title: Optional TSO wash after RT
steps.instruction: If TSO dimers are problematic, after RT place plate on magnet 3 min, discard supernatant, add 5 µL TSO‑wash cDNA amplification master mix, vortex, spin, and continue to cDNA amplification.

steps.title: cDNA amplification PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare cDNA amplification master mix (3 µL per reaction): 1.425 µL ddH₂O, 0.1 µL 5× HiFi Buffer, 0.025 µL 100 mM MgCl₂, 0.15 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 0.25 µL 10 µM Forward Primer, 0.05 µL 10 µM Reverse Primer, 0.1 µL KAPA HiFi 2× (final 0.5 U). Add 3 µL mix to each well, vortex, spin. Thermocycler: 98 °C 3 min; 18‑27 cycles (cell‑type dependent) of 98 °C 20 s, 65 °C 30 s, 72 °C 4 min; final 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C. Use 24 cycles for primary NSCs, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, neuroblasts, neurons; 20 cycles for pancreatic organoid cells.

steps.title: cDNA bead cleanup and QC
steps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads at 18‑25 °C for 30 min. Add 3 µL beads (0.6×) to each well, vortex 30 s, incubate 10 min total (3 min ×3). Centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min. Prepare 18 mL 80 % EtOH, aliquot 41 µL per well. Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 20 µL EtOH, let beads dry 2 min. Elute with 8 µL nuclease‑free water, vortex 30 s, incubate 5 min (3 × 1 min vortex). Magnet 2 min, transfer supernatant (cDNA) to new plate. QC: measure 10 random wells with Qubit dsDNA HS (1 µL sample + 199 µL buffer+reagent), and run 1 µL on Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip (≤5 ng/µL).

steps.title: Normalize cDNA for tagmentation
steps.instruction: Measure cDNA concentration in each well. Normalize to 1 ng/µL (if plate average <1 ng/µL, normalize to 0.7 ng/µL). If no plate reader, average 10‑15 random wells and dilute to 1 ng/µL with nuclease‑free water. Target final concentration 0.4‑2.5 ng/µL per well.

steps.title: Prepare tagmentation master mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction (1.2 µL total): 0.8 µL Tagment DNA buffer, 0.4 µL Amplicon Tagment mix. Aliquot 1.2 µL into each well of a new 384‑well tagmentation plate.

steps.title: Tagment cDNA and add SDS
steps.instruction: Add 0.4 µL normalized cDNA (100‑1000 pg) to each well, vortex 30 s, spin, repeat vortex/spin twice more. Thermocycler: 55 °C 10 min, hold 4 °C. Add 0.4 µL 0.2 % SDS (70.66 µL per plate), vortex 30 s, spin, incubate 5 min at 18‑25 °C (optional: use NT buffer instead of SDS).

steps.title: Library amplification (Nextera or KAPA)
steps.instruction: Add 1.2 µL Nextera PCR Master Mix (or 3.2 µL KAPA HiFi 2×) to each well. Then add 0.8 µL Nextera Primer Index Mix (i5+i7, 12.5 µM each). Vortex 30 s, spin, thermocycler (Nextera): 72 °C 3 min; 98 °C 3 min; 98 °C 10 s (6‑16 cycles); 55 °C 30 s; 72 °C 30 s; 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C. Use 13 cycles for 500 pg input (primary brain cells) or 12 cycles for 400 pg input (organoid cells). If using KAPA, PCR program: 98 °C 20 s; 63 °C 15 s; 72 °C 30 s; final 72 °C 3 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: cDNA library bead cleanup and QC
steps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads at RT 30 min. Add 3 µL beads (0.75×) to each well, vortex 30 s, incubate 10 min (3 × 3 min). Centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min. Prepare 18 mL 80 % EtOH, aliquot 41 µL per well. Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 20 µL EtOH, dry beads 2 min. Elute with 7 µL nuclease‑free water, vortex 30 s, incubate 5 min (3 × 1 min vortex). Magnet 2 min, transfer supernatant to new plate. Perform a second cleanup: add 4.5 µL AMPure beads (0.65×), elute in 7 µL water. QC as in step 8 (Qubit and Bioanalyzer/TapeStation).

steps.title: Pool final cDNA library
steps.instruction: Normalize each well to 0.5 ng/µL. Using Mosquito HV, aspirate 5 µL from each column and dispense into a single column of a deep‑well pool plate (change tips each transfer). Transfer pooled column to a 2 mL tube (≈1920 µL). Mix by pipetting 10×. Split 960 µL into two 2 mL tubes. Perform 1× AMPure XP bead cleanup: add beads equal to volume, incubate 10 min RT, magnet 3 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 80 % EtOH, elute in 35 µL nuclease‑free water (resuspend beads in first tube, then transfer to second). Measure final pool concentration with Qubit dsDNA HS and assess fragment size on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation.

steps.title: Purify gDNA from beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads at RT 30 min. Add 15 µL beads (0.68×) to frozen gDNA plate, vortex 30 s, spin, incubate 30 min (3 × 10 min). Centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min. Prepare 18 mL 80 % EtOH, aliquot 41 µL per well. Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 20 µL EtOH, dry beads 2 min. Elute with 2.5 µL nuclease‑free water, vortex 30 s, incubate 5 min (3 × 1 min vortex). Do NOT aspirate water after elution.

steps.title: Bisulfite conversion of gDNA
steps.instruction: Place gDNA plate on magnet, add 16 µL pre‑warmed (37 °C) CT conversion reagent (do not vortex). Thermocycler: 98 °C 8 min; 64 °C 180 min; hold 4 °C. Plate may be stored 16‑24 h at 4 °C (max 24 h).

steps.title: First‑strand purification of gDNA
steps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads at RT 30 min. Add 17 µL beads (0.62×) to gDNA plate, vortex 30 s, incubate 10 min (3 × 3 min), centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min. Prepare 18 mL 80 % EtOH, aliquot 41 µL per well. Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 20 µL EtOH, dry beads 2 min.

steps.title: Prepare 2° strand synthesis mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction (12 µL): 9.8 µL ddH₂O, 1.22 µL 10× Blue Buffer, 0.49 µL 10 mM dNTP mix, 0.49 µL 10 µM Adaptor 2 Oligo, final volume 12 µL. Aliquot mix for the whole plate.

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis PCR
steps.instruction: Add 12 µL 2° strand synthesis mix to each well, vortex 30 s, spin, incubate 1 min RT (repeat vortex/incubate twice more, total 5 min). Transfer reactions to a non‑magnetic plate. Heat 95 °C 45 s, cool to 4 °C on ice. Add 0.3 µL Klenow‑exo (total 12.3 µL). Thermocycler: 4 °C 5 min; ramp 4 °C → 37 °C at 4 °C/min (8.25 min); 37 °C 90 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Second‑strand purification
steps.instruction: Equilibrate 18 % PEG buffer at RT 30 min. Add 12 µL nuclease‑free water to each well, mix, then add 18 µL PEG buffer (final bead proportion 0.74×). Vortex 30 s, incubate 10 min (3 × 3 min), centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min. Prepare 18 mL 80 % EtOH, aliquot 41 µL per well. Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 20 µL EtOH, dry beads 2 min.

steps.title: gDNA library amplification PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare KAPA library amplification master mix (12 µL per reaction): 5.75 µL ddH₂O, 6.25 µL KAPA HiFi 2×, total 12 µL. Add 12 µL mix to each well, vortex 30 s, spin. Add 0.5 µL Index mix (UDI primers). Thermocycler: 95 °C 2 min; 14 cycles of 94 °C 80 s, 65 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final 72 °C 3 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: gDNA library bead cleanup and QC
steps.instruction: Equilibrate 18 % PEG buffer at RT 30 min. Add 12 µL nuclease‑free water, then 18 µL PEG buffer (0.73× bead proportion). Vortex 30 s, incubate 10 min (3 × 3 min), centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min. Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 20 µL 80 % EtOH, dry beads 2 min. Elute with 7 µL nuclease‑free water, vortex 30 s, incubate 5 min (3 × 1 min vortex). Magnet 2 min, transfer supernatant to new plate. QC as in step 8 (Qubit and Bioanalyzer/TapeStation).

steps.title: Pool final gDNA library
steps.instruction: Normalize each well to 0.5 ng/µL. Pool 3 µL from every well into a tube (use Mosquito HV to transfer, change tips each column). Split pooled volume into two tubes, perform 1× AMPure XP bead cleanup (add beads equal to volume, incubate 10 min RT, magnet 3 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 80 % EtOH, elute in 35 µL nuclease‑free water as described in step 14). Measure final pool concentration with Qubit dsDNA HS and assess fragment size on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation.

steps.title: Final cDNA library quality check
steps.instruction: Run representative cDNA libraries on a Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip (or TapeStation). Expected fragment size 500‑900 bp; primer dimers (50‑150 bp) should be ≤ the cDNA peak. If primer dimers persist, perform an additional 0.8× AMPure XP bead purification.
